verdict.rationale: Polar's docs support a fast integration path. They claim "Payments & Billing with 6 lines of code" and offer three checkout surfaces: no-code links, embedded checkout and the Checkout Session API. They also document official typed TypeScript and Python SDKs, framework adapters that make adding checkouts and webhooks "dead simple", a copy-paste `polar listen` command for local webhook testing, and an isolated sandbox for end-to-end test payments. missing for 10: actual copy-paste code samples shown in the evidence, SDK coverage beyond TypeScript and Python, independent or hands-on corroboration that a working flow can be built in under a day.
